definitions.short: Eltekeh or Elteke , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H514. Elteqe or Elteqeh אֶלְתְּקֵה אֶלְתְּקֵא, proper name, of a location Levitical city in the tribe of Dan, between Ekron & Timna , Assyrian Altaku (COT) Josh 19:44 ; 21:23 .
definitions.rootNote: or (more properly) אֶלְתְּקֵה ; of uncertain derivation;
